item.title: Retention for vzdump backups after off-site transfer – retentions
item.author: invalid@example.com (tkn777)
item.dc:creator: tkn777
item.content:encoded:
I use vzdump for my Proxmox VE backups, but I deliberately keep backup creation, transport and retention as separate steps.

My workflow looks roughly like this:

Code: 
vzdump
↓
vzdump hook
↓
copy/move completed backup to another location
↓
retentions
↓
apply the retention policy

For example, after the backup has been transferred to the actual backup storage, I can keep:
  • 7 daily backups
  • 4 weekly backups
  • 12 monthly backups
with:

Code: 
retentions /backup/proxmox '*.vma.zst' -d...
